an2.130:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] 2. 3. 12. 1. saddho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ sammā āyācamāno āyāceyya :
an2.130:1.3: esā bhikkhave tulā, etaṃ pamāṇaṃ mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yadidaṃ sāriputtamoggallānāti.
an2.131:1.1: saddhā bhikkhave bhikkhunī evaṃ sammā āyācamānā āyāceyya :
an2.131:1.2: tādisā homi, yādisā khemā ca bhikkhunī uppalavaṇṇā cāti.
an2.131:1.3: esā bhikkhave tulā, etaṃ pamāṇaṃ mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ yadidaṃ khemā ca bhikkhunī, uppalavaṇṇā cāti.
an2.132:1.1: saddho bhikkhave upāsako evaṃ sammā āyācamāno āyāceyya :
an2.132:1.2: tādiso homi, yādiso citto ca gahapati, hatthako ca ālavakoti.
an2.132:1.3: esā bhikkhave tulā, etaṃ pamāṇaṃ mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ yadidaṃ citto ca gahapati, hatthako ca ālavakoti.
an2.133:1.1: saddhā bhikkhave upāsikā evaṃ sammā āyācamānā āyāceyya :
an2.133:1.2: tādisā homi, yādisā khujjuttarā ca upāsikā, velukaṇṭakiyā ca nandamātāti.
an2.133:1.3: esā bhikkhave tulā, etaṃ pamāṇaṃ mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ yadidaṃ khujjuttarā ca upāsikā, veḷukaṇḍakiyā ca nandamātāti.
an2.134:1.1: dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati.
an2.134:1.5: imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati.
an2.134:2.1: 2. 3. 12. 6. dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito byatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca puññaṃ pasavati.
an2.134:2.5: imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito byatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati. anavajjo ca hoti, ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ. bahuñca puññaṃ pasavatīti.
an2.135:1.1: dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ. bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati.
an2.135:1.3: ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā appasādanīye ṭhāne pasādaṃ upadaṃseti.

an2.135:2.3: anuvicca pariyogāhetvā appasādanīye ṭhāne appasādaṃ upadaṃseti,
